skillPackages.title: 技能包

skillPackages.createPackageHint: 技能包是可共享的技能集合。创建后可添加技能，并在专家上挂载使用。
skillPackages.packageDescriptionPlaceholder: 可选，简要说明该技能包的用途
skillPackages.emptyGuideDesc: A skill package groups reusable skills so you can mount them on experts and use them in chat.
skillPackages.emptyGuideStepWhatDetail: A skill is a playbook (SKILL.md) that tells an expert how to complete a task, such as research, filling forms, or calling tools.
skillPackages.emptyGuideStepHowDetail: Create a package, add skills or import them from the market, then mount the package on an expert. Those skills will be available in chat.
skillPackages.emptyGuideStepShareDetail: Packages are visible to signed-in users on this instance. Others can mount them; only the creator can edit or delete.
skillPackages.selectPackage: Select a skill package to view its skills
skillPackages.deletePackageConfirm: Delete this package and all of its skills?
skillPackages.deletePackageMountedHint: Experts that mount this package will unmount it at the same time, and skills from this package will no longer be available on those agents.
skillPackages.copyPolicyHint: Controls whether users other than the creator can copy this package's skills into their agents. Read-only copies are enforced on Dashboard and workspace HTTP writes; Agent tool writes still need harness support (#770).
skillPackages.fromSkillHubHint: 将 SkillHub 技能集导入为新的技能包。
skillPackages.emptyGuideDesc: 技能包把一组可复用的技能收在一起，挂到专家后即可在对话中使用。

plugins.guideTitle: How to build and import a plugin
plugins.guideDevelopBody: Create a folder with plugin.yaml and an entry Python file (for example main.py). plugin.yaml needs id, version, name, kind (tool / skill / hook), and entry. In setup(ctx): tool → ctx.tool(...); skill → ctx.skills("skills"); hook → ctx.middleware(...). See the repo plugins/ demos for each kind.
plugins.guidePackageBody: Zip the plugin so the archive contains exactly one plugin root with plugin.yaml inside it (either at the zip root or in a single top-level folder). Example: zip -r my-plugin.zip my-plugin/
plugins.guideImportBody: Host the .zip where Octop can download it over HTTP(S). Prefer a raw file URL. Configure each agent from Personalization → Plugins. Local demos: octop plugin install ./plugins/demo-toolkit --force
